test-set.name: fn-transform
test-set.description: Tests for implementation specific options for the fn:transform() function

test-case.name: fn-transform-1
test-case.description: Error - The transform option xslt-version is higher than the version of XSLT supported by this processor

modified.change: Set requested version to something much higher

test-case.test: declare variable $xsl as xs:string :="<xsl:stylesheet xmlns:xsl='http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform' version='2.0'> <xsl:template match='/'> <out> <xsl:value-of select='.' /> </out> </xsl:template> </xsl:stylesheet>"; transform(map{"stylesheet-text":$xsl, "source-node":parse-xml("<doc>this</doc>"), "xslt-version":17.0 })

test-case.name: fn-transform-2
test-case.description: Transform using 'vendor-options' option to set Saxon configuration feature (defaultLanguage)

test-case.name: fn-transform-3
test-case.description: Transforms using 'vendor-options' option to set Saxon configuration feature (defaultLanguage); also tests cache false option

test-case.name: fn-transform-4
test-case.description: Transform using 'vendor-options' option to set Saxon configuration feature (version-warning)

test-case.name: fn-transform-5
test-case.description: Transform using 'vendor-options' option to set Saxon configuration feature (initialMode)
test-case.test: let $config := <configuration edition="PE" xmlns="http://saxon.sf.net/ns/configuration"> <xslt initialMode="first"/> </configuration> return transform(map{"stylesheet-node":$xsl, "source-node":$xsl, "vendor-options": map{QName('http://saxon.sf.net/', 'configuration'): $config} })

test-case.name: fn-transform-7
test-case.description: Transform using 'vendor-options' option to set schema-validation = lax. There's no schema, so lax validation should succeed; the main point of the test is that it doesn't reject the option

test-case.name: fn-transform-8
test-case.description: Transform using 'vendor-options' option to set schema-validation = strict. There's no schema, so strict validation should fail
